preconditions.description: The length of the input string is no more than 10000 characters.
The text begins and ends with a Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all((stdin[i].isalpha() and stdin[i+1].isalpha()) or stdin[i+1] == ' ' for i in range(len(stdin)-1) if stdin[i].isalpha() and stdin[i+1] != ' ')
postconditions.description: There is exactly one space between two words if there is no punctuation mark between them.

postconditions.expression: all(stdin[i] in '.,!? ' for i in range(len(stdin)))
postconditions.description: The output contains only lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and punctuation marks (dot, comma, exclamation mark, and question mark).

postconditions.expression: all(stdin[i] not in '.,!?' or stdin[i+1] == ' ' for i in range(len(stdin)-1))
postconditions.description: There is exactly one space after each punctuation mark.

postconditions.expression: all(stdin[i] not in '.,!?' or stdin[i-1] != ' ' for i in range(1, len(stdin)))
postconditions.description: There are no spaces before each punctuation mark.
